req.title: Task title max length
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title exceeds the maximum length constraint.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return an HTTP 422 status code when the task title exceeds the maximum length constraint. This implies that the system must enforce a maximum length for task titles and handle cases where this constraint is violated. The test suite will include a positive test to ensure valid titles are accepted, a negative test to verify that overly long titles are rejected, and a boundary test to check the exact limit of the title length.

tests.name: test_create_task_with_valid_title_length
preconditions: The task title length is within the allowed maximum length.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title of maximum allowed length.
expected: The response contains the created task with the correct title.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={
        "title": "a" * 100,  # max length
        "description": "A valid task description",
        "completed": False
    }
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "a" * 100

tests.name: test_create_task_with_exceeding_title_length
preconditions: The task title length exceeds the allowed maximum length.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title exceeding the maximum allowed length.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={
        "title": "a" * 101,  # exceeding max length
        "description": "A valid task description",
        "completed": False
    }
)

assert response.status_code == 422

tests.name: test_create_task_with_boundary_title_length
